purpose.description: The retrieval purpose for the search request. Well-known values: `search` (general search or filter browse requiring `query`, `filters`, or an extension input; default when omitted), `recommendation` (complementary or related items anchored to `reference_ids` and/or `context`), `swap` (functional substitute items requiring `reference_ids`). Businesses MUST reject or return an empty `products` array with an error message for unsupported values rather than falling back to a general browse.

reference_ids.description: Anchor product or variant identifiers for relational discovery. Requires `purpose` (e.g., `recommendation` or `swap`; MUST NOT be `search`). Implementations MUST support product ID and variant ID; MAY support secondary identifiers (SKU, handle, etc.). Referenced items MUST be excluded from the returned products.

actions.description: Outstanding extension-defined Actions for this catalog search response.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the search results.

policies.description: Policies (e.g., return/refund terms) that apply to the products in these search results. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.
